name: THE PATRONS
note: Card players above the tabletop, as their own sprite with their own beat. The sheet holds each man’s colours -- the far-left man’s shirt is RGB 98,71,45 in both his poses, against a browning to 101,61,31 in the sheet before it -- and nobody puts his cards down to drink: the dark-coated man’s card hand is byte-identical, 1228 opaque pixels, in both. The blue-coated man lays his cards down; the right-hand man turns and raises his. They share a band because their arms overlap and no column between them is safe to cut on, so the band alternates: one of them moves each beat, and which one changes each time.

sprite.note: A beat: at rest, and every few seconds ONE movement plays. Intervals of 13, 19 and 9 seconds share no factor, so they never fall into a pattern.
